verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's own write API documents deletion controls: conditional deletes and delete-by-filter, which let users remove matching documents programmatically. The pack has no evidence of retention policies, TTL or auto-expiry, or what happens to deleted data in object storage and backups, so only the deletion half of the story is covered. Missing for 10: documented retention policies/TTL, namespace-level deletion and post-deletion purge guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Delete by filter: deletes documents that match a filter.
Conditional writes: upsert, patch, or delete a document only if a condition.
